title: holcus annuus subsp. setiglumis
intro: Holcus annuus subsp. setiglumis, commonly known as False Oats or Brome, is a type of plant that belongs to the grass family and is native to Europe. It has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, including digestive problems and respiratory ailments. The plant is known to have health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions of reducing inflammation and protecting against cell damage. The bioactive constituents of Holcus annuus subsp. setiglumis include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
